NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into as of January 10, 2026, by and between Lisa Park (hereinafter "Disclosing Party") and Brian Torres (hereinafter "Receiving Party").

1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential business relationship and in connection therewith may disclose certain confidential information.

2. EFFECTIVE DATE. This Agreement shall be effective as of January 10, 2026 and shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027.

3. OBLIGATIONS. The Receiving Party agrees to hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence.

4. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

Disclosing Party: Lisa Park
Receiving Party: Brian Torres
